in_marathi.name: Ayeera
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayeera हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ayeera is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayu' meaning 'life' and 'Ri' meaning 'night'. The name symbolizes the light of the moon illuminating life during the night. In Hindu mythology, the moon god is often depicted as the giver of life and the sustainer of all beings.
